answer: Pay outsiders to expose fake clusters. Every account posts a deposit, and anyone who publishes a reproducible proof that two accounts share one operator, such as reused signing nonces, collects both deposits after a short challenge period. Marble and onyx can look unrelated until a cut shows the same quarry; a detection bounty works like a prism, splitting private hunches into public evidence. Each extra identity then adds one more deposit at risk and one more clue for hunters.
